messages.subject: using reshape.
parts:
New to R and reshape and having a problem. I'm working with time
series count data that has been summarized by year. Years that have 0
counts are missing from the dataset. The structure of the data is
simple:

variables: year id value

I am using reshape to add the 0s for years where the data is
missing.
> head(ca_har,10)
Year Province_ID Species_code value SE
1 1980 NB 1590 378 28
2 1980 NF 1590 12084 1154
3 1980 NS 1590 8143 887
4 1980 PE 1590 59 6
5 1980 PQ 1590 7109 513
6 1981 NB 1590 461 49
7 1981 NF 1590 4502 685
8 1981 NS 1590 10635 1063
9 1981 PQ 1590 9245 628
10 1982 MB 1590 471 50
.....

>ca_har.cast=cast(ca_har,Year~Province_ID, sum)
>ca_har.cast
Year AB BC MB NB NF NS NT ON PE PQ
1 1980 0 0 0 378 12084 8143 0 0 59 7109
2 1981 0 0 0 461 4502 10635 0 0 0 9245
3 1982 0 0 471 128 13353 6089 0 0 0 3557
4 1983 0 0 0 133 23202 17038 0 0 0 9488
5 1984 0 0 0 0 19844 6144 0 209 0 7555
6 1985 0 0 0 225 10983 3802 0 101 0 4305
7 1986 0 0 0 516 19678 6794 0 73 102 2984
8 1987 0 0 510 256 14239 5586 0 0 0 5272
.....
>ca_har=melt(ca_har.cast)
>ca_har Year value Province_ID
NF 1980 12084 NF
NF.1 1981 4502 NF
NF.2 1982 13353 NF
NF.3 1983 23202 NF
NF.4 1984 19844 NF
NF.5 1985 10983 NF
NF.6 1986 19678 NF
.....

This works fine. The problem I'm having is melting the data after I
have manipulated x.cast. For example, I'd like to create a new
variable in x.cast from the new id variable. for example:

>ca_har.cast$AFdresseri.tot=ca_har.cast$NB+ca_har.cast$NS ...
>ca_har.cast
Year AB BC MB NB NF NS NT ON PE PQ NF.dresseri
AF.dresseri AF.tot
1 1980 0 0 0 378 12084 8143 0 0 59 7109 3021.00
18710.00 27773
2 1981 0 0 0 461 4502 10635 0 0 0 9245 1125.50
21466.50 24843
3 1982 0 0 471 128 13353 6089 0 0 0 3557 3338.25
13112.25 23127
4 1983 0 0 0 133 23202 17038 0 0 0 9488 5800.50
32459.50 49861

>ca_har=melt(ca_har.cast)
Year value Province_ID
NF 1980 12084 NF
NF.1 1981 4502 NF
NF.2 1982 13353 NF
NF.3 1983 23202 NF
NF.4 1984 19844 NF
NF.5 1985 10983 NF
NF.6 1986 19678 NF
NF.7 1987 14239 NF
NF.8 1988 15854 NF
NF.9 1989 9240 NF
NF.10 1990 8220 NF
NF.11 1991 9122 NF
....
In this manipulation the new variables are not included, and I still
have the original Id variable (Province_ID). I've exported this data,
and re-read the text file and the melt works fine. Does anyone have
an idea what I'm doing wrong?

Thanks
Scott Gilliland

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: using reshape.
parts:
reshape tried to do some tricky things with the cast output which
often cause problems. You can either remove the extra attributes with
as.data.frame or switch to using reshape2 (which is also much faster)

Hadley
